title: Apple might release new iPhone colors this year including red blue and orange AAPL
text: Apple might release new iPhone colors this year including red blue and orange AAPL Details Email Apple could release new iPhone colors later this year, including "grey, white, blue, red, and orange." The colorful phone would be a new less expensive model with facial recognition and an edge-to-edge screen, according to details from TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo. advertisement The Opinion Poll When families are arrested and separated after attempting to enter the United States illegally, who is more to blame – the parents for breaking the law or the federal government for enforcing the law?
